## Landed: Gerrit 3186, merged as edf66bc13a007c8f9023fee92e53ef568fdf7f3d (2026-10-31 18:55 PDT)

Patch set 2 (0eb0ab64c8e): LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved. Submitted revision-scoped with scripts/gerrit_safe_submit.py; Gerrit rebased onto main. Plan re-reviewed after the helper moved (PASS, signed at 0eb0ab64c8e).

Evidence per acceptance criterion (arm64 macOS, load average about 42 on 18 cores):
- State paths: `test_observability_env_redirects_every_state_path` and `test_the_parse_covers_every_host_state_line` pass; the parse finds 17 defaults, equal to the 17 non-comment `/var/lib/rebar` lines.
- Refusal: `test_an_unredirected_state_path_is_refused_by_name` deletes REGION_CACHE and gets an AssertionError naming `REGION_CACHE=/var/lib/rebar/probe-region`, with `subprocess.Popen` replaced by a spy that fails if called. That proves no process starts before the refusal (structural, not a wall-clock bound; the repo's wall-clock-assert lint forbids the latter).
- Literal guard, AST run-site guard + anti-vacuity, host-docker refusal, induced-timeout reaping: all in `tests/scripts/test_observability_harness_isolation.py`, 10 passed.
- 21 test_observability_* files: 229 passed in 533 s after the change (219 passed in 945 s before, same host). After patch set 2: tests/scripts/ + the 2 repr-security modules: 1675 passed, 2 skipped.
- `/var/lib/rebar` absent before and after every run; no observability.sh process from this worktree survived any run.
- make lint rc 0; make typecheck rc 0; `infra/scripts/observability.sh` unchanged versus origin/main; no skip or platform marker added.
- Per-run time: before, real docker 15.9 s / 16.9 s vs stub 5.5 s / 5.0 s; after, default harness env 5.3 s / 5.5 s, host docker forced back in 17.4 s / 12.6 s.

Known limits (advisory LLM-Review findings, not acted on): the AST guard does not follow an argv bound to a variable before the subprocess call; `communicate()` after SIGKILL has no timeout; one test asserts the INSTANCE_ID_CACHE derivation by source text.

Not in this change: `make verify` on arm64 macOS still also needs bug degraded-chilly-galago (pandoc).
